facts.text: Caroline painted a sunset over the ocean after visiting the beach last week.

evidence.quote: I painted it after I visited the beach last week.

facts.text: Melanie expressed that Caroline's painting captured the serenity of the sunset and transported her to that moment.

evidence.quote: The art really took me to that moment and I can feel the serenity.
It means a lot to me that you can feel the sense of peace and serenity.

facts.text: Melanie mentioned spending the day with her family volunteering at a homeless shelter the day before the session.

evidence.quote: I was actually just remembering yesterday, spending the day with my fam volunteering at a homeless shelter.
